faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.description: Everything you need to know before your first visit.

q1.question: Are your vehicles certified?
q1.answer: Every car passes a 150-point inspection by our master technicians, with full service history and a 12-month powertrain warranty.

q2.question: Can I book a test drive without an appointment?
q2.answer: Walk-ins are welcome, but private test drives are best booked in advance so a specialist can prepare the vehicle for you.

q3.question: Do you accept trade-ins?
q3.answer: Yes. Submit your vehicle details online and receive a no-obligation estimate. A certified appraiser confirms the final offer.

q4.question: What financing options are available?
q4.answer: Financing is arranged through partner lenders for terms from 12 to 84 months. Estimates are illustrative; approval depends on the lender.

q5.question: Do you deliver outside Almaty?
q5.answer: Yes. Concierge delivery is available across Kazakhstan with insured door-to-door transport.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains how {name} handles the personal data you share through this website.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.text: Only what a request needs: your name, e-mail, phone, the vehicle you ask about, preferred appointment time and any message you write. For financing and trade-in requests we also store the figures you enter.

use.title: Why we use it
use.text: To contact you about your request, arrange test drives, reservations and service, and keep a record of agreed sales. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

access.title: Who can see it
access.text: Only dealership employees whose role requires it. Financing details are limited to finance staff. Access is logged.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: For as long as needed to serve you and meet record-keeping obligations. You can ask us to anonymise your personal data at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You may ask what data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, withdraw consent or ask for it to be deleted, in line with the personal data law of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

privacy.disclaimer: This notice is a plain-language summary prepared for the website and should be reviewed by the dealership's legal adviser.
